description: Rejects applying smooth Taylor expansions or standard implicit function theorems across non-smooth deltoid cusps.
negative_fixture: The gradient of det(H(theta)) is smooth at theta=0, so linear Taylor expansion gives valid interval bounds.
positive_fixture: At the 3 deltoid cusps, d/dtheta det(H(theta)) vanishes; exact fractional Lipschitz collars of radius 1/256 seal the singular locus.
